sn38.14:1.6: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.14:1.7: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.14:1.8: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.14:1.9: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etāsaṃ dukkhatānaṃ pariññāya, seyyathidaṃ:
sn38.14:1.11: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.14:1.12: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānaṃ pariññāya.
